services.name: Audio_QueueControlMarker0C
services.behavior: Calls Audio_QueueBegin, writes marker 0xFF and control byte 0x0C through Audio_QueueWriteMarker, then calls Audio_QueueEnd.

services.name: Audio_QueueControlMarker0D
services.behavior: Calls Audio_QueueBegin, writes marker 0xFF and control byte 0x0D through Audio_QueueWriteMarker, then calls Audio_QueueEnd.

conclusion: The two anonymous audio wrappers are fixed control-packet boundaries around the frame input/resource service. Their packet identities and queue ownership are proven; the audio engine's internal meanings for control bytes 0x0C and 0x0D remain intentionally unassigned.
